notes.title: Demo Patch #1: Camera Controls, Tax Nerf, Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Everyone![/h3][p][/p][p]My name is Daniel. You might know me from the forums or discord. My main job on Whiskerwood is as a programmer, but I also act as the game director. This means it is my honour and pleasure to say [b]thank you for playing our game![/b][/p][p][/p][p]So many players have checked out our demo -- It has been an incredible half week, far beyond our wildest expectations.[/p][p][/p][p]The volume of feedback has been overwhelming but I’m trying to reply to everyone and make tickets for every improvement we can find as a team. Of course any change we make is about making the game better and more special. Everything needs to work towards our vision for Whiskerwood.[/p][p][/p][p]I have a couple of big changes I want to call out for this Patch. These are the features players have requested the most and we were able to land in this Update:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Added VSync setting[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Nerfed Admin tax[/b]. It now increases at 20% of the prior speed. Aka: it is 80% lower over time.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now [b]pan by holding the middle mouse[/b] and dragging.[/p][/*][*][p]We are in the process of adding a right mouse click and hold to rotate, but for now due to bugs in menus we have mapped this feature to holding Ctrl. Thus [b]holding CTRL and moving the mouse will rotate the camera[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rewritten whisker path finding[/b]. This might have its own bugs, but overall should bring more stability and fewer pathfinding misses.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed farm grown trees disappearing[/b] once deposited in the farm building.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed Whiskers not collecting new clothing[/b] when Threadborn.  [/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]The full change log will be below, but I want to also mention a few important changes we wish to make but which did not finish in time for this patch:[/p][olist][*][p]Moving stone dumps still delete any whisker inside.[/p][/*][*][p]The terraforming will become an inverted mining tool with zoning and a work camp, replacing the stone dump.[/p][/*][*][p]Over capacity Cafes still win in preference over the warehouses. So once you build a single cafe please make sure you build more once it gets full.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][p][b]v0.6.149.0 Demo Patch #1[/b][/p][p][b]Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Make shift + R rotate in opposite direction[/p][/*][*][p]Make Middle Mouse hold pan camera[/p][/*][*][p]Make Ctrl + mouse orbit camera when held[/p][/*][*][p]Update DLSS to latest version[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduce increase speed of admin tax by 80%[/p][/*][*][p]Make whiskers eat food at non-central warehouses[/p][/*][*][p]Make logging, forage, mining, farms give full refunds[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce how frequently statues drain happiness[/p][/*][*][p]Make line must go up quest trigger on a non-pirate day[/p][/*][*][p]Replace low-tier with high-tier clothing for high-tier supplies[/p][/*][*][p]Make starting pirate cannon ball count 8 not 10[/p][/*][*][p]Make high seas only pirate setting disabling in-island pirates and disable the related quests [/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fix whisker background behind icon not having uniform radius[/p][/*][*][p]Add Lucas Riccoiotti to credits for the OST[/p][/*][*][p]Make all panels display the total available amount of Royal Wax Seals next to reroll buttons[/p][/*][*][p]Fix end of season reporting "Ends Tonight" instead of "Ends Tomorrow" [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bugs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fix crash when moving camp[/p][/*][*][p]Fix save/load forgetting to allocate gift reward[/p][/*][*][p]Fix Tree farm logs disappear when reaching farmbuilding[/p][/*][*][p]Fix Whisker stuck at top of stairs[/p][/*][*][p]Fix embark dock line flickering 1 frame on 1 frame off during dlss frame generation[/p][/*][*][p]Remove obsolete tools from supplies[/p][/*][*][p]Fix manual assignment of whiskers fails to handle occupied houses[/p][/*][*][p]Fix crash in height visualizer[/p][/*][*][p]Fix incorrect colony name may be displayed upon loading a save[/p][/*][*][p]Fix flashing and pulsing white dots on ocean under certain upscalers[/p][/*][*][p]Fix DLSS FG labels not displaying[/p][/*][*][p]Attempt fix for DLSS-FG stuck enabled (untested due to no dlss fg on dev machine)[/p][/*][*][p]Fix crash when exiting to main menu[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3]Join, Discuss, and Keep Informed About Whiskerwood[/h3][hr][/hr][p]You can find us on [url="https://discord.com/invite/uRKrjRgbM2"]Discord[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/minakatadynamics.bsky.social"]BlueSky[/url], [url="https://x.com/Minakata_DM"]Twitter[/url], and [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/Whiskerwood/top/"]Reddit[/url] for discussions, updates, and feedback. You can also visit our [url="https://minakatadynamics.co.jp/"]website[/url] for more information.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2489330/Whiskerwood/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
